transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess... they made me come. Because of work. At the warehouse. 

I don't know, I just... I keep doing things. Like standing by the forklift and... freezing. With my arms up. And copying the beeping noises it makes, or the hand signals. I was moving the boxes in these... strange little patterns. Everyone kept yelling for me to stop, but... yeah. That's why.
Do you feel like you have to do these things, like copying the beeping noises or moving the boxes in certain patterns?
I don't... I'm not really sure. It just... happens. I don't really think about if I have to or not.
Do you ever hear voices or sounds that other people can't hear?
No... I don't think so. Just the regular stuff. The warehouse is loud, but... no voices. Just the machines. Everyone hears those.
Do you feel anxious when you're not doing these repetitive behaviors, like copying the beeping noises or moving boxes in patterns?

No... I don't think so. It's not... I don't feel anxious. 

I just... do it. I don't really feel much of anything if I stop. It's just what happens.
Do you have thoughts that keep repeating in your mind?
No. Not really. I don't... pay much attention to what I'm thinking. Just regular stuff, I guess. Nothing like that.
Have these behaviors, like freezing by the forklift or moving boxes in patterns, caused problems for you at work or with your relationships?

I guess... yeah. They took me off the forklift. Said it wasn't safe around me anymore. 

And... I've fallen behind in my classes at the community college. I stopped going to my shifts at the church food bank, too. People just... they kept saying they can't count on me. So I stopped going.
Do you often feel like you don't quite fit in with others or have behaviors that are considered unusual by those around you?
I don't know. I guess... maybe. People look at me sometimes. But I don't really think about fitting in. I just... do my own thing, mostly. I don't know if it's unusual. It's just what I do.
Do you have difficulty making or keeping friends?
I don't know. I don't really... try to. I just stay by myself mostly. So... I don't know if it's hard. I just don't do it.
Do you feel awkward when you're around other people?
Not really. I just... I don't really talk to anyone, so... there's nothing to feel awkward about, I guess. I just stay out of the way.
Do you feel like people avoid you or don't understand you?
I don't really know. I don't pay attention to what other people do. They just... do whatever they do. I don't think about if they understand me.
Do you have thoughts that you feel compelled to think about over and over?
No... not really. I just... think about whatever. I don't get stuck on things like that.
Did you have any problems with learning or developing skills as a child?
No... not that I remember. School was fine, I guess. I didn't really have any problems like that.
Do you feel like you have trouble understanding what other people are feeling or thinking?
I don't know. I don't really try to figure out what people are thinking. I just... keep to myself, mostly. It's not something I really pay attention to.
Do you find it hard to start or continue conversations with others?
I don't really... talk to people much anyway. There's not really a reason to. So... I don't know if it's hard. I just don't do it.
Do you have thoughts that you feel are silly or unnecessary, but that you cannot stop thinking about?
No... I don't really have that. My thoughts are just... whatever they are. I don't think they're silly. I just think about what I need to.
Did you have any strong, specific interests as a child that you felt very drawn to?
Not really. I don't remember having anything like that. I just... did whatever, I guess. Nothing specific.
Do you have any thoughts that keep coming back to you, even when you try to think about something else?
No... I don't think so. They just kind of... come and go, I guess. I don't really pay attention to if they keep coming back.
Do you ever feel like you're thinking about something over and over even when you don't want to?
No. I mean... like I said, it's just regular. I don't really get stuck on things. It's not like that.
Do you have any thoughts that you feel compelled to think about, even if you don't want to?
I don't... no. I don't feel forced to think about anything. Like I said, it's just... normal. I don't really know what else to tell you.
Do you have any thoughts that you feel compelled to think about over and over?
No. I already said no. It's just... I don't get stuck like that. I don't know why you keep asking the same thing.
